answer: Random beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop forgery. Each epoch the beacon samples 10% of vertices and issues a cipher; every sampled vertex must answer within one hour to prove live compute. A miss burns 20 POA; a second miss burns the whole stake, leaving a frozen relic until it re-stakes. Forging 1,000 identities locks 40,000 POA and burns 2,000 POA per epoch. An honest agent pays one 40 POA stake and keeps earnings undiluted.
